ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Communication.Voices
ModMetaData.author: Nitori_Tachyon
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Communication.Voices speaks RimAI.Communication dialogue aloud.
Assign a voice per colonist, start or stop speech at any time, and keep TTS in sync when Communication skips a line. Voice providers and keys are configured in this module's settings.
Requires Harmony and RimAI.Communication. Gameplay text AI stays in shared RimAI settings.
